# pvecli vm clone

Clone a VM.

```text
pvecli vm clone [VMID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | Source VM ID. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-ni`, `--newid N` | New VM ID (auto-assigned if not specified). |
| `-na`, `--name VALUE` | New VM name. |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` | Pool name. |
| `-ob`, `--onboot` / `--no-onboot` | Start at boot. |
| `-fu`, `--full` | Create full clone (templates only; default is linked). |
| `-ta`, `--target VALUE` | Target node (the source's disks must be on shared storage). |

## Examples

```bash
pvecli vm clone 100                                  # Interactive mode
pvecli vm clone 100 --newid 101 --name my-vm         # Non-interactive
pvecli vm clone 100 --newid 101 --full --target node2 # Full clone to another node
```
